spans.s: Ṛcīka^1, a form or son of Vivasvat (the Sun). § 3 (Anukram.): I, 1, 42 (sa Ṛcīkaḥ, v. Āśāvaha).

Ṛcīka^2, a ṛshi, son or descendant of Bhṛgu, and father of Jamadagni and Śunaḥśepha. § 8 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 275 (ºādayaḥ…pitaro, sc. Rāma Jāmadagnya's).--§ 122 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2611 (son of Aurva and father of Jamadagni).--§ 395 (Jamadagni): III, 115, 10146 (Bhārgavaḥ), (10149), 10154 (Ṛ. married Satyavatī, having given as a dowry 1,000 horses which he obtained from Varuṇa; birth of Jamadagni).--§ 398 (Paraśurāma): III, 117, 10205 (among the pitṛs of Rāma Jāmadagnya).--§ 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 117, 3973 (reme…yathā…Rºḥ Satyavatyāñ ca); 119, 4005, 4007 (had given 1000 horses as a dowry for Satyavatī, cf. § 395).--§ 573 (Ambopākhyānap.): V, 185, 7312 (munayo…Ṛºmukhāḥ, the pitṛs of Rāma Jāmadagnya, headed by Ṛ. caused Rāma to desist from the battle with Bhīshma).--§ 638b (Rāmopākhyāna): XII, 49, 1721 (Bhṛguputrāya), 1723 (Bhārgavaḥ), 1726 (Bhṛgunandanaḥ), 1727, 1731 (Bhṛguśārdūlaḥ), (1738), (1740), (1743), 1746 (the story of the birth of Jamadagni (and Viśvāmitra) once more related, deviating a little from § 395).--§ 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7599 (putraḥ… Rºsya…Jamadagniḥ).--§ 677 (do.): XII, 235, 8607 (Dyutimat gave his kingdom to Ṛ. and thus attained to heaven).--§ 721 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 3, 186 (ºsyātmajaś saiva Śunaḥśephaḥ).--§ 721b (Viśvāmitrop.): XIII, 4, 207 (Bhārgavaḥ…Cyavanasyātmasambhavaḥ), 208, (210), 215, 217, 223, 228, 260 (Ṛ. married Satyavatī, having given as a dowry 1,000 horses which he obtained from Varuṇa; birth of Jamadagni (and Viśvāmitra), cf. § 395 and § 638b).--§ 745c (Cyavana-Kuśikasaṃv.): XIII, 56, 2910 (Bhṛgunandanaṃ, Cyavana prophesied that Ṛ. would be born from Ūrva, and marry the daughter of Gādhi [i.e. Satyavatī]).--§ 767 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 137, 6267 (Dyutimat gave his kingdom to Ṛ. and thus attained to heaven).--§ 771 (do.): XIII, 151, 7158 (ºtanayaiḥ).--§ 782d (Paraśurāma): XIV, 29, 836 (ºpramukhāḥ…pitāmahāḥ, told Rāma Jāmadagnya to desist from slaughtering the kṣhatriyas). Cf. Bhārgava, Bhārgavarshabha, Bhṛguśārdūla, Bhṛgunandana, Bhṛguputra, Bhṛgusattama, Bhṛgusuta, Brahmarshi, Viprarshi.
Ṛcīka^3, son of Bhūmanyu. § 152 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3714 (sixth son of Bhūmanyu and Pushkariṇī).

Ṛcīkanandana, “[grand]
son of Ṛcīka” = Rāma Jāmadagnya: III, 8657.
Ṛcīkaputra (“son of Ṛcīka”) = Jamadagni: III, †10223(?), 10519(?); XIII, 7671 (Jº).
